summary: Astrotech Corporation filed an 8-K to disclose an increase in its at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program. The company had previously entered an ATM agreement with H.C. Wainwright, selling 258,856 shares for gross proceeds of roughly $7.9 million under a prior prospectus supplement. On August 19, 2026, it filed a new prospectus supplement for up to $50 million in common stock sales, superseding the earlier supplement. This is a routine capital-raising disclosure under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation; the filing includes a legal opinion from Haynes and Boone. What to watch: potential dilution from continued ATM sales, but no special-situation angle.
